_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

close.text: Map a room with Companion Scan. Visit ci dot computer. UnCloud your life.

the-walk.text: Walk the room and watch a spatial map form as you move.

two-ways-in.text: Walk a room with the camera, or hand it a walkthrough video you already have.

the-meter.text: Coverage is scored while you walk, off the point count itself. It goes from sparse to good, and the app is the thing that says so.

named-not-numbered.text: The map is not just geometry. Every object keeps the label it was given, and the confidence it was given with.

pick-a-room.text: Pick any room and the camera frames it. Its tag, its notes and where it sits are all yours to change.

how-good-a-map.text: Then open the world editor to clean up and organize the result.
